application_type_full: Householder planning & demolition in a conservation area
description: Erection of a single storey rear extension, a side roof extension with one front roof window and addition of two side roof windows.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (GA-P-1000 P01, GA-P-1001 P01, GA-P-1002 P01, GA-P-1003 P01, GA-P-1004 P01, GA-P-1005 P02, GA-P-1006 P03, GA-P-1007 P03, GA-P-1008 P04, GA-E-2000 P01, GA-E-2001 P03,  GA-S-3000 P01, GA-S-3001 P02, GA-AXO_7000 P01,  GA-AXO_7001 P03, Design & Access Statement received 23 August 2021; Fire Statement Form received 6 September 202) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
Condition : 4 - The roof lights shall be 'conservation style', installed to be flush with the existing roof slope.
Condition : 5 - The window formed in the side dormer shall be obscure glazed, hinged to open inwards and shall not be repaired or replaced otherwise than with obscured glazing.
